importTransaksi.title: Import Transactions via Excel
importTransaksi.formatHint: Column format: Date, Account Code, Account, Debit, Credit, Note. Rows sharing the same date (with an empty date below) are treated as one compound transaction. Max 5000 transactions. Account codes must already exist in Master Data → Accounts (COA).

akun.title: Accounts (COA)
akun.openingBalanceHint: The opening balance is automatically offset to the "Opening Balance" equity account (created automatically if it doesn't exist yet), so the Balance Sheet stays balanced.
akun.name: Name *

aset.title: Assets
aset.errDeprLifeRequired: If "Depreciation Start Date" is filled in, "Useful Life" is required too.
aset.name: Name *
aset.autoCreatedHint: Assets appear here automatically once you record a transaction that debits a "Fixed Assets" category account (via the Transactions menu). Here you just configure its depreciation schedule.

importAkun.title: Import Accounts (COA) via Excel
importAkun.formatHint: Excel column format: Code, Name, Category, Normal Balance, Description. Category must be one of: {{categories}}. Normal Balance: debit or kredit. Max 200 rows.
importAkun.errMaxRows: Max 200 rows per import. This file has {{count}} rows.
importAkun.errInvalidCategory: Row {{row}} ({{code}}): category "{{category}}" is invalid. Must be one of: {{valid}}
importAkun.errInvalidNormalBalance: Row {{row}} ({{code}}): normal balance must be "debit" or "kredit"

importAset.title: Import Assets via Excel
importAset.formatHint: Excel column format: Code, Name, Account Code, Description, Acquisition Date, Acquisition Cost, Depreciation Start Date (optional), Useful Life (months) (optional), Salvage Value (optional). "Account Code" must already exist in Master Data → Accounts (COA) under the Fixed Assets category. Max 200 rows.
importAset.errMaxRows: Max 200 rows per import. This file has {{count}} rows.
importAset.errAccountNotFound: Row {{row}} ({{code}}): account code "{{accountCode}}" not found under Fixed Assets category

importKontak.title: Import Contacts via Excel
importKontak.formatHint: Excel column format: Name, Email, Phone, Address. "Name" column is required, the rest are optional. Max 500 rows.
importKontak.errMaxRows: Max 500 rows per import. This file has {{count}} rows.

tutupBuku.title: Year-End Closing
tutupBuku.viewerNotice: Only the Owner can perform a year-end closing. You can view the history below.
tutupBuku.explainer: This process will zero out the balances of all Revenue and Expense accounts from{{since}} through the date you select, then transfer the difference (net profit/loss) to the Retained Earnings account. Once closed, you can no longer add/edit transactions on or before the closing date. Only admins can do this, and this action cannot be undone.
tutupBuku.confirmMsg: ⚠️ Are you sure? This can't be undone. Click once more to confirm.
tutupBuku.successMsg: Year-end closing successful! This period's net profit/loss has been moved to "Retained Earnings".

saldoAwalPersediaan.title: Opening Stock Balance
saldoAwalPersediaan.boxTitle: For Migrating from a Previous System
saldoAwalPersediaan.boxDesc: Use this page to record stock you already had BEFORE starting to use My Worksheet. The value is posted to the "Opening Balance" equity account (not treated as a new purchase), and the stock is immediately ready for future sales.

costCenter.title: Branch / Cost Center
costCenter.pageHint: Use this page to split transactions by branch, division, or project — so you can see the profit/loss of each separately via the Report by Branch.

jurnalPembalik.title: Reversing Entries
jurnalPembalik.pageHint: Create a reversing entry from an existing transaction — all its debit/credit lines are automatically swapped on a new date. Commonly used to reverse adjusting entries at the start of the next period.

transferAntarCabang.title: Branch Transfer
transferAntarCabang.boxDesc: This is NOT a sale — it just moves the physical location of goods. There's no impact on revenue or financial journals, only inventory moving from one branch to another.

returPembelian.boxDesc: Stock is automatically reduced at the selected branch, and the funds are refunded (cash/bank) or reduce the payable to the supplier — depending on the account you choose.

returPenjualan.boxDesc: Stock is automatically added back at the selected branch (using the current average cost), Sales Revenue is automatically reduced, and funds go back to the customer or reduce the receivable — depending on the account you choose.
